data.narrative:
Multiply Labs is a Series A–stage biotech company founded by Fred Parietti and Alice Melocchi, having raised $41M+ to date. The valuation exercise draws on a peer universe of 3 public companies in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, and Chai Discovery.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given data constraints. The stage-progression approach uses $85M as a proxy for total capital raised to date, then applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression, yielding $170M. This reflects the company's advancement beyond seed but acknowledges the limited visibility into unit economics or revenue. Public-comparable anchoring using the Biotech & Health sector median P/S of 5.6x cannot be applied without disclosure of Multiply Labs' revenue. Peer-median triangulation likewise cannot proceed due to insufficient same-stage or valuation-tier private comparables meeting minimum thresholds.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $144M to $195M, centered on $170M. This range reflects the typical band around stage-progression midpoint but remains heavily dependent on the 2.0x multiplier assumption and the $85M proxy. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue data, limited peer set granularity for biotech at this stage, and no direct insight into capital efficiency or clinical milestones. Any material shift in burn rate or pipeline progress would warrant reassessment.
